title: Tasan 90-day pilot – Lapin hyvinvointialue (Lapland)

signer.role: Johtajaylilääkäri / Chief Medical Officer, Lapland wellbeing services county (Lapin hyvinvointialue)
signer.verified: role holder verified on the county website, 14 Nov 2026

problem.line: In Lapland, about 16 in 100 men with lung cancer get curative treatment, against about 30 in 100 in Vantaa-Kerava (age-adjusted).
problem.metric: Age-standardised share of lung-cancer patients receiving curative treatment, 2019–2023, men: Lapland ≈16.2% (95% CI 12.7–20.4) vs Vantaa-Kerava ≈29.8% (24.2–36.1). Women: 23.1% vs 39.7%.
problem.source: Finnish Cancer Registry/THL/FICAN, Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023 (23.4.2026), Kuva 16 – https://syoparekisteri.fi/assets/themes/ssy3/factsheets/keuhkosyoparaportti.html
problem.caveat: Values read from the chart by the Tasan data team (±1 pp); not published numbers.
problem.people_estimate: About 12 more lung cancer patients a year in Lapland would have had a curative-treatment record if Lapland matched the national share [Tasan arithmetic from crude Cancer Registry counts, both sexes, diagnosed 2019–2023: (27.0% − 18.5%) × 710 patients ÷ 5 years; not age- or stage-adjusted; illustrative, not a causal or lives-saved estimate]. Source: Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, Taulukko 11.

people_headline.label: more Lapland lung-cancer patients would have a curative-treatment record at the national share (illustrative)

action.summary: T3 pathway clock: measure each suspected lung cancer from referral to first treatment, raise an alert on day 28 with no treatment decision, and give every patient a named nurse navigator.
components: Clock: the 4 THL time points (referral, specialist visit, diagnosis, first treatment) per patient, weekly feed from county data.
Day-28 alert: open pathways without a treatment decision go to the navigator and the responsible physician.
Named nurse navigator (1.0 FTE): contacts every new suspected case and unblocks waits.
Data-quality task: registry-completeness check first (Lapland has 33.8% of cases with no treatment record; drug-therapy recording is low).

owners.role: Signer / sponsor: Johtajaylilääkäri / Chief Medical Officer, Lapland wellbeing services county (Lapin hyvinvointialue)
Navigator line manager: vs. hoitotyön johtaja / Acting Director of Nursing, Lapin hyvinvointialue
Data / clock: county analytics unit / tietojohtaminen (to be assigned by the county)

cost_range.basis: 1.0 FTE sairaanhoitaja (€3,174–4,048/month) + 0.5 FTE analyytikko (€4,663–4,891/month) × 3 months × 1.2314 employer contributions. Low = task-based pay, high = total earnings.
cost_range.excludes: No IT, physician time or treatment capacity costed (no sourced figure). No euro saving claimed.

kpis.name: Data completeness
kpis.baseline_method: Days 1–30: count of pathways with all 4 time points in 12 months of county data

kpis.name: Treated within 42 days of referral
kpis.baseline_method: Own baseline measured in days 1–30 and presented to the board

kpis.name: Navigator contact
kpis.target: ≥90% of new suspected cases within 3 working days

kpi_caveat: The 42-day figure follows THL Ohjaus 21/2016 (6 weeks referral → first treatment), which is marked outdated and has no lung-specific limit; cancer-specific targets are due 2026–2028. All targets are Tasan design choices. The long-term outcome (age-adjusted curative share) is tracked, not promised.
timeline: Days 1–30: extract 12 months of time points, completeness check, publish baseline, name navigator.
Days 31–60: weekly feed, day-28 alert live, navigator acts.
Days 61–90: first board report incl. non-pathway waits; day-90 stop/go.

stop_go.go: Go (extend) if ≥85% of pathways have all 4 time points, the own baseline is presented to the board, ≥90% of day-28 alerts are actioned within 2 working days and ≥90% of new cases are contacted within 3 working days.
stop_go.stop: Completeness <70% after one fix cycle: pause the clock and fix recording first. Otherwise extend 90 days with one named fix.
stop_go.decider: Johtajaylilääkäri, on the day-90 board report

az_role.summary: AstraZeneca could co-fund the independent 90-day evaluation and the registry-completeness work, and provide project-management/service-design support. No patient steering, no product, no promotion, no patient-level data to AZ; the county owns data and decisions.
az_role.compliance_framework: Pharma Industry Finland Code of Ethics 2026, §35 (grants to healthcare organisations only to support healthcare or research, documented, never an incentive to prescribe; the company must not be the only funder) and §124–125 (transfers to healthcare organisations published by name).
az_role.note: Any funding model needs AZ's own compliance review. AZ does not pay clinical staff.

precedents.name: Estonia lung-cancer patient-pathway PPP
precedents.description: Ministry of Social Affairs, Health Insurance Fund (Tervisekassa), AstraZeneca, MSD, Roche (later also Pfizer) and the Connected Health Cluster (Tehnopol) signed a consortium to map and improve the lung-cancer pathway. A national service-design and data project, not a county pilot.

caveats: No existing AstraZeneca–wellbeing-county pilot in Finland is claimed.
Partner arm with OYS (Oulu board / radiotherapy access) is conditional; OYS leads are unverified – see appendix.
